display.purpose: Georgia hero headline on .wild-home; italic emphasis remains part of the composition.

headline.purpose: Home serif headings; individual sections retain their implemented overrides.

page-display.purpose: Unbounded page-intro heading outside the home serif override.

shadows.name: client-preview
shadows.purpose: Home client preview; desktop perspective(1000px) rotateY(-7deg) rotateZ(1deg), hover rotateY(-2deg) rotateZ(0); transforms removed on mobile and reduced motion.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Home entrances, reveals, hover image scale and cat transitions.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Scene assembly and palette transitions; implemented by assemblyEase().

motion.name: hero-copy-enter
motion.purpose: Initial hero copy entrance. Disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: content-reveal
motion.value: 650ms; opacity and translateY(22px) to 0; intersection threshold 0.12
motion.purpose: Home content reveals once; items already in the viewport remain readable. Reduced motion removes pending reveals and transitions.

motion.name: home-controls
motion.purpose: Home buttons; active scale also applies to the motion preview toggle.

motion.name: hero-motion-control
motion.purpose: Hero pause control; aria-pressed reflects explicit user pause. Hidden when reduced motion is active or no scene exists.

motion.name: project-hover
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer image hover; reduced motion removes scaling.

motion.name: hero-pointer
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer response only. Pointer contribution: x translation 0.07, y rotation 0.12, x rotation 0.075 in scene units/radians.

motion.name: hero-ambient
motion.value: 12s vertical breathing; 18s x/z rotational variation; 16s y rotational variation
motion.purpose: Small ambient movement of the single sculpture.

motion.name: hero-layers
motion.value: 18s cycle; opening starts 4.2s + stage*0.18s and lasts 1.7s; closing starts 7.3s + stage*0.13s and lasts 2.1s; stage=min(contourIndex,2)
motion.purpose: Gentle separation. Both colored contours use identical translation (0.015, 0.025, 0.07), zero independent tilt, and the same stage so their connection persists.

motion.name: hero-palette
motion.value: 8s per palette: 6s hold + 2s eased blend; 24s complete blue/lime/orange cycle
motion.purpose: Changes sculpture material and rim lighting. UI semantic accents remain stable.

motion.name: hero-scroll
motion.value: damping 4; vertical -0.22; y rotation +0.13; scale reduction 0.035 at full scroll progress
motion.purpose: Restrained scene reframing with clamped hero scroll progress from 0 to 1.

motion.name: hero-pause-policy
motion.value: cancel requestAnimationFrame when user-paused, reduced-motion, hero offscreen, document.hidden or WebGL context lost
motion.purpose: Preserve elapsed state without a catch-up jump on resume. Reduced motion retains a static sculpture; paused resize can render one updated frame. Initialization failure/context loss exposes the SVG fallback.

motion.name: cat-hide
motion.purpose: Explicit visibility:hidden is applied before prints can be created. Default/return transition is 200ms.

motion.name: cat-scroll-settle
motion.value: 220ms scroll idle delay; 750ms print fade; then remove every print before revealing cat
motion.purpose: Visible cat and pawprints are mutually exclusive, including resumed scrolling during a fade.

motion.name: cat-print
motion.value: 180ms entrance; 92px scroll distance per step; maximum 3 prints; 46px desktop / 34px mobile stride with alternating 6px / 4px lateral offset
motion.purpose: Prints alternate along the planned journey and are suppressed when no safe point is available.

motion.name: cat-placement
motion.purpose: Safe candidates come from real design-element edges. Desktop cat 84x132px; 761–1480px cat 68x107px; <=760px cat 55x86px. No safe candidate returns null and keeps the cat hidden.

motion.name: cat-motion-policy
motion.value: no scroll activity under reduced motion, document.hidden, open menu or open dialog; clear trail on resize, visibility change and reduced-motion change
motion.purpose: Reduced motion retains a static safely anchored cat, disables transitions and hides prints. Menu/dialog CSS hides the companion overlay. Page lifecycle cleanup removes listeners and the overlay when leaving a nonpersisted page.

motion.name: preview-playback-policy
motion.value: intersection threshold 0.2; pause while hidden, offscreen or user-paused
motion.purpose: Motion preview autoplay also respects reduced motion; explicit user play can opt in under reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
The existing home eyebrow supplies this phrase. Preserve the KK mark, Russian copy, dark surfaces and spacious editorial composition. Serif headings and italic emphasis give the home page its voice; Manrope carries navigation, descriptions and controls.

This records the incumbent identity and the approved home extension. The hero pairs copy with one solid KK sculpture; the outlined cat adds a small, independent companion. The detailed surface contract remains in `.impeccable/surfaces/home-hero.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal surfaces with clear type and generous space.
Stable blue, lime and orange roles.
Original KK geometry with metal depth and restrained movement.
Decorative motion that yields to content, user pause and reduced motion.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Keep blue for exploration, lime for client demonstrations and orange for starting a conversation. Section and action accents are local; sculpture lighting cycles do not change the page theme. `public/theme.js` removes the legacy saved theme attribute.

rules.name: The Home Type Rule
rules.body: Scope the serif display treatment to `.wild-home`. Other existing pages retain Unbounded headings; `page-display` records their page-intro role.

dos: **Do** preserve the original four KK contours and the connected colored portion.
**Do** keep existing Russian copy and controls readable on desktop and mobile.
**Do** retain the SVG fallback and a static reduced-motion sculpture.
**Do** defer the cat when a safe real element edge is unavailable.
donts: **Don't** turn semantic section accents into a global theme cycle.
**Don't** spread the home serif override to other pages.
**Don't** show the cat and visible pawprints together.
**Don't** cover text or controls with decorative elements.
